title: Implement Per-Container OOM Containment Limits
instructions: Append after the previous chunk without editing earlier lines. Satisfy NFR-VM-02: Out-of-memory container terminations shall be isolated to the offending container without crashing the VM kernel. Set --memory and --memory-swap to the same value so a container cannot swap past its slot, and never pass --oom-kill-disable, so the kernel kills only the offending container.
